declaration.label: JWE decryption for WAF inspection
declaration.remark: iRules and the WAF policy are INJECTED by tools/as3_submit.py from bigip/irules/*.tcl and bigip/waf/jwe-demo-policy.json. Do not paste them here by hand - the __PLACEHOLDER__ tokens are substituted at submit time so the .tcl files stay the single source of truth.

vs_waf_internal.remark: Inner VS of the chain. ASM lives HERE and nowhere else on this path, so it inspects an ordinary plaintext JSON POST with no HTTP::collect in its flow.

vs_jwe_ingress.remark: THE FIX. Decrypts, rewrites Content-Type, chains to vs_waf_internal. Deliberately has NO WAF policy of its own.

vs_jwe_blind.remark: THE BLIND SPOT. WAF policy attached, no decryption. An attack inside a JWE must reach the backend with a 200 here - that is the gap the lab exists to show.

vs_plain_waf.remark: CONTROL. Plaintext plus WAF. Proves the policy is actually armed, so a block on vs_jwe_ingress cannot be dismissed as coincidence and a 200 on vs_jwe_blind cannot be blamed on a dead policy.

vs_jwe_single.remark: EXPERIMENT. Decrypt and WAF on the SAME VS, to measure the K000158872 HTTP::collect/ASM interaction instead of assuming it. Not the production path.
